integrity: The proof is self-contained: it combines the exact Walsh-average representation with symmetry and independence, then uses the standard exact signed-rank null variance. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies the Walsh identity and null moments for finite samples and independently checks the uniform-parent covariance through order-statistic expectations. Computational checks are supplementary and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an atomless distribution symmetric about the true center and uses the untied Wilcoxon signed-rank statistic.
The finite covariance is a null-distribution statement; shifted alternatives require a different calculation.
The equality between squared limiting correlation and Pitman asymptotic relative efficiency is asserted only for the normal parent.
A residual bibliographic risk remains because two highly relevant historical articles were available only as image scans with unusable substantive text layers.
title: Wilcoxon signed-rank and sample mean have an exact Gini covariance
